heuristics.name: typical collocation
heuristics.description: pick the option that most readily completes a stock SC sentence frame (arboreal species, desalinate seawater, ratify treaty, fitfully slept, void contract)

heuristics.name: rarest / most test-worthy word
heuristics.description: when nothing else discriminates, pick the most advanced vocabulary (hygroscopic, friable, quiescent, punctilious)

heuristics.name: odd one out by valence
heuristics.description: pick the single option whose valence differs from the other three (unruffled among hostile words, foundered among growth words)

heuristics.name: coherent two-blank pair
heuristics.description: for two-blank items pick the pair whose halves form a natural contrast or consequence (austere/lavish, homage/transforms, lucid/summarize)

notes: Distractors are mostly as specific and rare as plausible keys, so options alone give little signal. All 100 picks are guesses; no option was certainly ruled out, including in two-blank items where any pair can be made coherent by a contrast frame, so reject_certain is false throughout.
